findings.finding: HW-06 and HW-07 require refusal of a witness whose rhs wires are garbage (adversarial INTERNAL witness). Their refs (hostile/H5-R1, H5-R2 and heldout rows) run with Tamper::none, i.e. honest completion of a permissive claim; that is the same evidence mode HW-01..04 are labelled RELATION-PARTIAL for. HW-23 requires 'Bool wire value 2 or p-1 used as true'; r3 executes value 2 on two ENTRY Bool wires (M-10/wire, HW-23-r3/H6-B1/wire-two) and p-1 only as a public-field edit (binding refusal); computed internal Bool wires (Eq flag, products) are not exercised. The class RELATION-EXECUTED on HW-06, HW-07 and HW-23 therefore overstates the executed witness mode.
findings.effect: No relation or outcome change. Risk: an ALL-REFS-OK parser result for HW-06/07/23 read as adversarial-internal-witness evidence.
findings.minimum_repair: Record (dated, outside the frozen addendum-4 bytes) that HW-06, HW-07 and HW-23 are RELATION-PARTIAL, or add a per-ref witness_mode {honest-completion | tampered-entry-wire | public-field-only}. See proposals/MINIMUM-REPAIRS.md R-A.

findings.finding: plan.rs emits one shared message for both caps ('represented cells exceed Core's 4,096 balances or 1,024 liabilities'), so the substring check '4,096' or '1,024' cannot show which cap fired. My own arithmetic (below) shows each construction reaches its designated cap and no other: cells = 4,097 frame cells with 1 registry duty and trace 4,099 x 3 = 12,297; duties = 1,026 registry duties with 0 cells and trace 1,028 x 3 = 3,084. The trace rows are discriminated by message ('65536'). No at-cap admission control (4,096 cells, 1,024 duties, trace exactly 65,536) exists; the frozen S-9 requires only refusal.
findings.effect: Outcome determined by construction; check is weaker than its label.
findings.minimum_repair: Optional AUTH addendum row printing plan-side counts or an at-cap admission control; not required for S-9 as frozen.

findings.finding: M-10 (frozen), M-11a, M-13 x3, HW-18-r3, HW-23-r3/H6-B1/{two,minus-one}, HW-26-r3/unsorted and every grossfees tamper-+1 row edit only the public vector while TransitionValues stay honest. Each is refused by the adapter binding equality (or a header constant). They show the public statement is bound, not gadget soundness. HW-26-r3/unsorted in particular has no row order to violate under DirectFieldV0 (fixed slot order), so its 'unsorted half executed' wording should read 'pre-cell public slots are bound'.
findings.minimum_repair: Carry this qualification into any result review; see R-A.

findings.finding: The rows assert ConstraintSystemRef::which_is_unsatisfied() == Some("0"). I did not read ark-relations 0.4.0 (cache access is outside this task), so the decimal-index format is UNVERIFIED-LIB for this review; the frozen source review section 5 did not list which_is_unsatisfied among verified APIs. Index 0 being input 0's booleanity follows from circuit.rs (entry region first, inputs first) and gadgets::alloc_bool (b*b=b), and from the label entry/input0#0 matching the only/first Bool input (H3 poly_b input v; H6 beq input p). The assertion depends on synthesis order, consistent with the source reviewer's dissent that constraint indices are not refusal codes.
findings.effect: If the library returns a trace string instead, the rows FAIL (harness-defect class), never pass.
findings.minimum_repair: None required; record as an AUTH structural assertion.

findings.finding: E0r3 executes review-overlay/r3-tools/copy_verify_r3.py directly from the author lane directory. Its hash is in pins_sha256 and R3-MANIFEST, but R3-MANIFEST is verified by the tool itself after it starts. The executed run had the same pattern: FREEZE.json pinned copy_verify_r2.py as an input, but run_pathb.py re-verified only itself and OPTION-A-PLAN before spawning E0r2.
findings.effect: A freeze-to-exec TOCTOU window on the E0 tool and on libtest_rows.py if loaded from a mutable path.

findings.finding: Frozen M-11b edit (lo + r, hi) is the identical field vector as the honest claim, so as a DirectFieldV0 public vector it is SAT by construction; the frozen 'UNSATISFIABLE' cannot be tested at this layer. Its intent ('no modular alias') belongs to a byte-image ABI mapping (ABI_V1_MAPPING_REQUIREMENTS: 16-byte big-endian UInt images range-checked). The proposed v2 (lo + 2^64, hi unchanged) is a different limb-range case, not M-11b.
